    day = date.day
    cum_days_before = [0, 31, 60, 91, 121, 152, 182, 213, 244, 274, 305, 335]

    sst_cell = target_sst[:, i, j]  # (n_target,)
    thr_cell = np.array([threshold_smoothed[doy - 1, i, j] for doy in target_doy])  # (n_target,)

    for t in range(n_target):
